scripts.text: for the first time, we would like to recommend that you check the locations of notable places in town with us.
scripts.translation: 问一个城镇时，我们建议您与我们一起查看城镇中重要地点的位置。

scripts.text: If you wish to take an Informative class, please walk around and speak to the various tutors in these Training Grounds. Have a good day.
scripts.translation: 如果您想上资讯课，请四处走动并与这些训练场中的各种导师对话。祝您愉快。

scripts.text: You have passed the 1st training course! Wow~ I guess now you understand a little bit more about Ragnarok Online.
scripts.translation: 通过了第一阶段的训练课程！哇~ 我想你现在对《仙境传说》有了一些更深的了解。

scripts.text: You will learn the fundamentals of actual battle through this class. If you did your best through the Informative class, you are supposed to have been given some starting equipment.

scripts.text: equipment before you engaging in battle. Are you sure you've equipped all of your equipment, your weapons and armor?
scripts.translation: 之前，请检查你的装备。你确定已经装备了所有的物品、武器和防具吗？

scripts.text: This will allow you to attack monsters by using the Heal skill without holding the shift key. Handy, huh?
scripts.translation: 这将允许你使用治愈术攻击魔物，而无需按住Shift键。很方便吧？

scripts.text: Do you understand these battle commands? Now, I will teaching you about monster behaviors and properties, experience gained through battle, and items you can earn from dead monsters.
scripts.translation: 你理解这些战斗指令了吗？现在，我将教你关于魔物的行为和属性、通过战斗获得的经验值，以及从死亡的魔物身上可以获得的物品。

scripts.text: Field Combat Training can be actually be pretty dangerous for new adventurers. Let me give you
scripts.translation: 野外战斗训练对新手冒险者来说可能相当危险。让我用

scripts.text: a little more strength through the power of my magic.
scripts.translation: 我的魔力为你增加一点力量。

scripts.text: There are many aggressive monsters that will attack you first before you even approach them.
scripts.translation: 有许多具有攻击性的魔物，它们会在你靠近之前先攻击你。

scripts.text: There are also a few monsters that will cooperate with others of their kind. Attack one of them, and the whole pack of them will swarm around you, seeking revenge.
scripts.translation: 也有一些魔物会与同类合作。攻击其中一个，它们整个群体就会围上来，寻求复仇。

scripts.text: Every monster can be specified by their types, sizes and properties. For example, there are Demi-human, Brute, Holy and Demon property monsters out there.
scripts.translation: 魔物可按种族、体型和属性分类。例如，有人形、动物、圣属性和恶魔种族的魔物。

scripts.text: When you're aware of what property a monster is, you can use that knowledge to help you in battle.
scripts.translation: 当你了解魔物的属性后，就可以利用这些知识来辅助战斗。

scripts.text: If you manage to get cards for that increase your damage upon certain monster properties, or reduce damage from specific monster properties, you'll have a much easier time in battle.
scripts.translation: 如果你能获取增加对特定属性魔物伤害，或减少来自特定属性魔物伤害的卡片，战斗将会轻松许多。

scripts.text: Monsters are separated by their size: small, medium and large. There are a few cards that allow you to do more damage to
scripts.translation: 魔物按大小分为小型、中型和大型。有一些卡片可以让你对特定大小的魔物

scripts.text: Also, each weapon has its strengths and weaknesses. The size of the weapon will affect the damage it will deal to monsters.
scripts.translation: 此外，每种武器都有其强项和弱项。武器的大小会影响它对魔物造成的伤害。

scripts.text: For example, Dagger class weapons do 100 % damage on small sized monsters but only inflict 50 % on large monsters.
scripts.translation: 例如，短剑类武器对小型魔物造成100%的伤害，但对大型魔物只造成50%的伤害。

scripts.text: Common monster properties include Water, Wind, Earth, Fire, Shadow, Ghost and Holy. If you attack a monster with an opposing property, you can inflict additional damage~
scripts.translation: 常见的魔物属性有水、风、地、火、暗、念和圣。用克制对方的属性攻击，就能造成额外伤害~

scripts.text: But if you attack a monster with
a skill or weapon that inflicts damage of the same property as the monster, the damage will be greatly reduced, or completely negated. You might even heal the monster!
scripts.translation: 魔物属性相同的技能或武器攻击它，伤害会大幅降低，甚至完全无效。你甚至可能会治疗魔物！

scripts.text: In the case of Ghost property monsters, normal weapons cannot do any harm. However, a weapon with any other property will be able to deal out some damage.
scripts.translation: 对于幽灵属性的魔物，普通武器无法造成伤害。然而，具有其他属性的武器可以对其造成一定伤害。

scripts.text: Basically, a character who deals the most damage on a monster receives the most experience points from the monster.
scripts.translation: 基本上，对魔物造成伤害最多的角色，会从该魔物身上获得最多的经验值。

scripts.text: Therefore, you receive a certain percentage of experience points in proportion to the damage you've inflicted on the monster, compared to its total HP.
scripts.translation: 因此，你获得的经验值比例，取决于你对魔物造成的伤害与其总HP的比例。

scripts.text: Let's say, there is a character named 'Z.' Z does 65 damage on a monster that has 100 total HP and gives 1000 experience points when it's dead. So, Z will receive 650 experience points.
scripts.translation: 假设有一个叫'Z'的角色。Z对一只总HP为100、死亡时提供1000经验值的魔物造成了65点伤害。那么，Z将获得650点经验值。

scripts.text: However, this rule applies differently following certain situations.
scripts.translation: 不过，在某些情况下，这条规则会有所不同。

scripts.text: If there are two people who both did 65 damage on the same monster, the experience points that each will receive differs, depending on the monster's remaining HP.
scripts.translation: 如果有两个人都对同一只魔物造成了65点伤害，他们各自获得的经验值会根据魔物剩余的HP而有所不同。

scripts.text: For instance, somebody does damage to a monster while you're already hitting it, and he did the same amount of damage you did.
scripts.translation: 例如，当你正在攻击一只魔物时，另一个人也对其造成了伤害，且伤害量与你相同。

scripts.text: In this case, you will receive 2//3 of the whole experience points that monster can give you, the other one will receive 1//3.
scripts.translation: 在这种情况下，你将获得该魔物总经验值的2/3，而另一个人将获得1/3。

scripts.text: However, attacking a monster that somebody already started to hit is not suggested in Ragnarok Online. That action is regarded as ill-mannered behavior.
scripts.translation: 然而，在《仙境传说》中，不建议攻击别人已经开始攻击的魔物。这种行为被视为不礼貌。

scripts.text: For party play, the party master can set the experience distribution to the equally share option.
scripts.translation: 在队伍游戏中，队长可以将经验分配设置为“平均分配”选项。

scripts.text: With this method, party members can share their experience according to the their character levels, and the number of members in the party.
scripts.translation: 通过这种方式，队伍成员可以根据他们的角色等级和队伍中的人数来分享经验值。

scripts.text: Also, there is the experience benefit for party play which allows you to gain more experience points than playing solo. You can take advantage of this system for faster leveling.
scripts.translation: 此外，队伍游戏还有经验加成，允许你获得比单人游戏更多的经验值。你可以利用这个系统来更快升级。

scripts.text: you can obtain items by chance. Furthermore, certain characters can use the 'Steal' skill in order to steal items from monsters.
scripts.translation: 有机会获得物品。此外，有些职业可以使用“偷窃”技能，从魔物身上偷取物品。

scripts.text: Don't you worry about the Steal skill causing you to not find any items after you kill them. Using the Steal skill does not at all affect the item drop rate for monsters once they're killed.
scripts.translation: 不用担心使用“偷窃”后，击败魔物就不会掉落物品。偷窃技能完全不会影响魔物被击败后的掉落率。

scripts.text: When a group of people kill a monster, the person who did the most damage receives priority in picking up item drops.
scripts.translation: 当一群人共同击杀一只魔物时，造成最高伤害的人拥有拾取掉落物品的优先权。

scripts.translation: 您不妨先和这个房间左边的助手对话，接受一些战斗指导？

scripts.translation: 野外战斗训练是一堂实战课，您可以获得用于在米德加尔特自卫的基础战斗技能。

scripts.text: Please kill as many monsters as you can to increase your base level at least 2 times.
scripts.translation: 请尽可能多地击杀魔物，将您的基础等级至少提升2级。

scripts.text: Gaining 2 base levels is required to complete your Field Combat Training. Although the monsters are all weak and easy to kill, I hope you will be careful.
scripts.translation: 提升2级基础等级是完成野外战斗训练的必要条件。虽然这些魔物都很弱且容易击杀，但我希望您能小心行事。

scripts.translation: 在《仙境传说》中，剑士通常担任坦克的角色，保护其他职业的角色免受攻击或伤害。

scripts.text: A Swordman is the ideal character to take the position of party leader. When advancing to the Second Job Class, Swordmen can change their jobs to ^8E2323Knights^000000 or ^8E2323Crusaders^000000.
scripts.translation: 剑士是担任队伍首领的理想人选。在转职为二转职业时，剑士可以转职为骑士或十字军。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: The Mage class specializes in using the forces of Fire, Water, Earth and Lightning to attack their enemies.
scripts.translation: 魔法师职业擅长利用火、水、土和雷的力量攻击敌人。

scripts.text: However, due to their weak physical strength, they are only allowed to equip Rods and Knives as weapons, and wear light armor for defense.
scripts.translation: 然而，由于体力较弱，他们只能装备法杖和匕首作为武器，并穿着轻型护甲进行防御。

scripts.text: Despite their physical weakness, they are able to do massive damage with their powerful spells. This fact alone attracts many people to join this class.
scripts.translation: 尽管体力较弱，但他们能凭借强大的法术造成巨额伤害。仅凭这一点就吸引了许多人选择这个职业。

scripts.text: In Ragnarok Online, the Mage takes a heavily offensive role in parties and is depended upon to deal great damage to enemies.
scripts.translation: 在《仙境传说》中，魔法师在队伍中担任主要的输出角色，负责对敌人造成大量伤害。

scripts.text: When advancing to the Second Job Class, Mages can change their jobs to ^8E2323Wizards^000000 or ^8E2323Sages^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职为二转职业时，魔法师可以转职为巫师或贤者。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: The Archer class are experts in using Bow weapons, and are useful in parties for their long range attacks.
scripts.translation: 弓箭手职业是擅长使用弓的专家，在队伍中因其远程攻击能力而非常有用。

scripts.text: Despite being physically weaker, Archers possess high accuracy with powerful long range bows. This allows them to attack and kill monsters from a safe distance.
scripts.translation: \n弓箭手虽然体力较弱，却拥有很高的命中率，还能使用威力强大的远程弓箭，因此可以在安全距离外攻击并击败魔物。

scripts.text: In Ragnarok Online, Archers have relatively little HP, but their long range attacks allow them to easily dispatch enemies before the enemy gets close enough to hurt them.
scripts.translation: 在《仙境传说》中，弓箭手的HP相对较少，但他们的远程攻击使他们能够在敌人靠近造成伤害之前轻松解决它们。

scripts.text: When advancing to the Second Job Class, every Archer may advance to the ^8E2323Hunter^000000 class. Alternatively, male Archers may advance to become ^8E2323Bards^000000, and female Archers may become ^8E2323Dancers^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职为二转职业时，所有弓箭手都可以转职为猎人。或者，男性弓箭手可以转职为诗人，女性弓箭手可以转职为舞娘。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: The Merchant class specializes in commerce. Due to the strong influence of the Merchant Guild, the Merchant class is attractive to those who wish to focus on earning Zeny.
scripts.translation: 商人职业擅长商业。由于商人公会的强大影响力，商人职业对希望专注于赚取Zeny的人来说很有吸引力。

scripts.text: In Ragnarok Online, the Merchant class possesses various economic abilities. Merchants can learn to sell items to NPCs for higher prices, as well as receive discounts from NPCs.
scripts.translation: 在《仙境传说》中，商人职业拥有各种经济能力。商人可以学习以更高的价格向NPC出售物品，也可以从NPC处获得折扣。

scripts.text: a Cart that greatly expands their carrying capacity and allows them to open shops with their own items and prices.
scripts.translation: 推车，这极大地扩展了他们的携带容量，并允许他们用自己的物品和价格开设商店。

scripts.text: When advancing to the Second Job Class, Merchants can change their jobs to ^8E2323Blacksmiths^000000 or ^8E2323Alchemists^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职为二转职业时，商人可以转职为铁匠或炼金术士。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: Thieves are experts at using Dagger class weapons. They strike quickly and easily evade attacks from their enemies.
scripts.translation: 盗贼是短剑类武器的专家。他们出手迅速，并能轻松躲避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text: Thieves can learn skills that allow them to hide from their enemies, or steal items from monsters. They are also feared for their use of poison, which slowly weakens
scripts.translation: 盗贼可以学习从敌人面前躲藏，或从魔物身上偷窃物品的技能。他们使用毒药的能力也令人畏惧，毒药会慢慢削

scripts.text: When advancing to the Second Job Class, Thieves can change their jobs to ^8E2323Assassins^000000 or ^8E2323Rogues^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职为二转职业时，盗贼可以转职为刺客或流氓。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: In Ragnarok Online, Acolytes act as messengers of God in Rune-Midgarts. They possess skills that support their allies, as well as the life saving Heal ability.
scripts.translation: 在《仙境传说》中，服事是卢恩·米德加兹的神之使者。他们拥有支援队友的技能，以及能救命的治愈术。

scripts.text: The Acolyte's support abilities make them a welcome addition to any party. In difficult situations, the Acolyte's skills will ensure the survival of the party, allowing other members to focus on offense.
scripts.translation: 服事的支援能力使他们成为任何队伍中受欢迎的成员。在艰难的情况下，服事的技能将确保队伍的生存，让其他成员专注于进攻。

scripts.text: When advancing to the Second Job Class, Acolytes can change their jobs to ^8E2323Priests^000000 or ^8E2323Monks^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职为二转职业时，服事可以转职为牧师或武僧。 ^8E2323^000000^8E2323^000000

scripts.text: Swordman is an expert in wielding Swords. They can also use Spear weapons, but typically you don't see Spear wielding Swordmen
scripts.translation: 是擅长使用剑的专家。他们也可以使用长矛类武器，但通常很少见到使用长矛的

scripts.text: Swordmen possess strong physical strength, allowing them to equip heavy armor and weapons. Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods, can be equipped by the Swordman class.
scripts.translation: 剑士拥有强大的体力，可以装备重型护甲和武器。除了弓和法杖外，剑士可以装备大多数武器类型。

scripts.text: The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells. However, this can be compensated by using weapons with an elemental attribute.
scripts.translation: 剑士唯一的弱点是无法使用魔法。不过，这可以通过使用带有属性攻击的武器来弥补。

scripts.text: One of the greatest benefits of being a Swordman is having an enormous amount of HP, meaning they can more easily withstand damage from their enemies.
scripts.translation: 成为剑士最大的优点之一是拥有大量的HP，这意味着他们能更轻松地承受敌人的攻击。

scripts.text: After learning some strong attack skills, the Swordman is almost unbeatable in a melee fight.
scripts.translation: 在学习了一些强力攻击技能后，剑士在近战中几乎无人能敌。
